# hs-opentelemetry-api-1.0.0.0

This directory contains a vendored copy of version 1.0.0.0 of the `hs-opentelemetry-api`
package, as only the self-contained `OpenTelemetry.Baggage` module is needed.

This vendored copy exports a subset of the full `hs-opentelemetry-api` API, so it
is important that development and testing is done against the vendored copy.
